cells.note: Rebuild 2026-10-28: the only Tier rung rests on an undated Sudatel page (SDN-007), and Sudani, its operator, said in January 2026 it lost its Tier-4 data centre (SDN-003). Its restored core data centre and the Khartoum State centre carry no tier, so stage 2, by judgement.
